English.Char_Desc_250: RetroGenY plays Game Boy Advance, Game Boy Color and Game Boy games on Android. Its own GBA and GB/GBC cores are accurate and fast, with save states, cheats, fast forward, rewind, cloud saves and link play.
English.Char_Desc_450: RetroGenY is a Game Boy Advance, Game Boy Color and Game Boy emulator for Android. Both cores are written from scratch from public hardware documentation, aiming for accuracy and speed. Features include save states, rewind, fast forward, turbo buttons, a large cheat database, game controller support, screen filters, cloud saves through your own Google Drive and link play. Bring your own game files; no games are included.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
RetroGenY is a Game Boy Advance (GBA), Game Boy Color (GBC) and Game Boy (GB) emulator for Android phones and tablets.
Accurate, fast cores Both the GBA core and the GB/GBC core are written from scratch from public hardware documentation. They are tested against hundreds of games and run full speed on most phones, with Vulkan and OpenGL renderers.
Features - In-game saves and save states - Rewind, fast forward and turbo buttons - A large built-in cheat database, plus your own Action Replay, GameShark and CodeBreaker codes - Game controller support with button mapping - Screen filters: LCD grid, ghosting, brightness, contrast and gamma - Cloud saves through your own Google Drive, and save export / import - Link play between phones - Cartridge sensors: solar sensor, tilt and gyro games use the phone's sensors - Portrait and landscape layouts, English and Chinese interface
RetroGenY is free. A one-time purchase permanently unlocks all premium features.
No games are included. Use game files you own.
